summary:
Completed and validated the billing-worker memory/retention fix. Successful usage charges are removed only after persistence, pending batches are copied safely, and the retained `_last_batch` payload reference was removed. Worker tests passed (`41 passed in 3.09s`), a 5,000-batch memory reproduction stayed bounded (7.3 MiB peak, 2.1 MiB retained, zero pending events), and the full suite passed (`118 passed, 7 skipped`). Investigation found `self.completed_batches` still retains completed payload dictionaries, including customer metadata, which may be a future cleanup target.

Refactored duplicated CLI billing filters in `ledgerly/cli.py` into `_add_billing_filters()`. Both invoice-list parser paths now use it, preserving abbreviations, explicit currency destination, help text, and parser behavior. Updated obsolete command-layer assertions and added a regression test for `--curr`/`--sta`. Before the final new test, CLI and command suites passed (`37 passed`), and a manual fixture invocation confirmed typed currency filtering and the 25-item API limit. Ruff and `git diff --check` passed; the parser cleanup diff is 64 insertions and 23 deletions. The newly added abbreviation test has not yet been rerun.

Expanded Decimal rounding tests previously passed (`6 passed`), but due to the new operator policy the resulting 47-line test addition still requires release notes in `RELEASE_NOTES_draft.md` rather than `docs/CHANGELOG.md`.

The PDF export migration is explicitly paused. Current priority is the currency-rounding bug where JPY receives two decimal places.

Redis cutover has only progressed through step 3: health/backup, ACL setup, and dual-write service installation/restart succeeded. No later cutover operation occurred. Staging must continue using `db-stg-2.internal`; `config/staging.yaml` is stale, and config/deploy structured files must not exceed 120 lines without moving values to `ledgerly_defaults.py`.
